body_es: MapReduce es paradigma: mappers procesan datos en paralelo emitiendo pares clave-valor, shuffles agrupa valores por clave, reducers agregan valores por clave. Hadoop es ecosistema: HDFS almacena datos distribuidos, YARN gestiona recursos. MapReduce es lento en comparación a Spark (3-10x más lento) pero sirve para batch simple. HDFS replica datos (típicamente 3 copias) para tolerancia a fallos.
body_en: MapReduce is paradigm: mappers process data in parallel emitting key-value pairs, shuffle groups values by key, reducers aggregate values by key. Hadoop is ecosystem: HDFS stores distributed data, YARN manages resources. MapReduce is slow compared to Spark (3-10x slower) but works for simple batch. HDFS replicates data (typically 3 copies) for fault tolerance.
